gate_policy.rationale: Three complete full-corpus replays reproduced the 2,237-function baseline exactly, while ordinary regions varied with wall-clock exact-zero paths, randomized hash topology, resolver scheduling, and a non-atomic derived-counter underflow. Regions remain diagnostic until a deterministic baseline reproduces across independent full runs.

identity_canonicalization.functions: lexicographically sorted arrays of [curl-relative file, function name]
identity_canonicalization.regions: lexicographically sorted arrays of [curl-relative file, function name, start line, start column, end line, end column]; LLVM region kind 0 only

corpus_boundary.note: The baseline covers the exact available-corpus snapshots identified above; inaccessible public archives were not measured.
